title: Show HN: ssh ssh.place
summary: ssh.place is a web-based SSH service that allows users to access remote servers directly through their browser, providing a convenient terminal experience without requiring local SSH client installation. This Show HN project garnered significant community interest with 122 points and 73 comments.
problem_solved: Eliminates the need for local SSH client setup by providing instant browser-based terminal access from any device.
why_valuable: Offers developers and sysadmins instant SSH access from any browser, making it ideal for quick debugging, education, or accessing servers from restricted environments.
